newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian coffee prices firm on global rally.
newsitem.headline: Indian coffee prices firm on global rally.

text.p: Indian arabica coffee prices rose sharply during the week in line with the rally in world coffee prices, traders said on Wednesday.

They said Arabica PB was quoted at 175-176 rupees per kg while Arabica A grade was priced at 181-182 rupees per kg. Last week Arabica PB was quoted at 165 per kg and Arabica A was traded at 168 per kg.
"Compared with last week, the prices have shot up sharply," an official with the Bangalore-based Karnataka Coffee Brokers Company Ltd told Reuters.
He said the export market was strong because of high world coffee prices.
"Robusta and arabica cherries were available in the market but there was tightening in arabica washed coffee," he said.
